meta.prompt: Draft an email to my landlord about the broken heating and show it as an inline card I can edit before it goes: to, subject and body fields filled in, a tone switch between polite and firm that rewrites the body, and send and discard buttons. Sending needs a recipient and a subject, and afterwards the card shows it as sent.
meta.text:
state to="landlord@example.com"
state subject="Heating not working in my apartment"
state tone="Polite"
state body="Hi,\n\nI hope you're well. The heating in my apartment has stopped working. Could you please arrange for someone to take a look as soon as you're able? I'm happy to work around your schedule for access.\n\nThank you very much,\nAlex"
state sent=false
state discarded=false
state valid=true

Card w:390 gap:12
  if sent
    Row gap:8 middle
      Icon "check_circle"
      Text.heading "Email sent"
    Text.muted "To: {to}"
    Text.strong "{subject}"
    Text.body "{body}"
  if discarded
    Row gap:8 middle
      Icon "delete"
      Text.heading "Draft discarded"
    Button.outline "Start over" -> discarded=false
  if !sent && !discarded
    Row between middle
      Text.heading "Draft email"
      Badge.info "Draft"
    Input "To" "name@example.com" =to
    Input "Subject" =subject
    SegmentedButton =tone items:["Polite","Firm"] -> body=(tone=="Polite" ? "Hi,\n\nI hope you're well. The heating in my apartment has stopped working. Could you please arrange for someone to take a look as soon as you're able? I'm happy to work around your schedule for access.\n\nThank you very much,\nAlex" : "Hello,\n\nThe heating in my apartment is broken and has not been working. This needs to be repaired promptly. Please confirm today when a technician will visit. If it is not fixed soon, I will have to look at my options under my tenancy agreement.\n\nRegards,\nAlex")
    Input "Message" =body lines:10
    if trim(to)=="" || trim(subject)==""
      Text.danger "Add a recipient and a subject to send."
    Row gap:8 end
      Button.ghost "Discard" -> discarded=true
      Button "Send" enabled:=trim(to)!=""&&trim(subject)!="" -> sent=true; emit send; toast "Email sent"
